text:
{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l4251_4571_n029",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the example contrasts a good response that gives an overview and asks what to focus on with a bad response that overloads the user with detail",
    "C2 for an open-ended planning question, a response that provides an overview and asks for direction is preferred over one that dumps all details at once",
    "C3 the bad response's fault is overloading the user with detail, not the content itself"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "voice_turn_taking_rule", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R is a voice response that aligns with the iterative, turn-taking conversation structure and adapts to conversational shifts",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l4251_4571_n029", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "overview_then_detail_response", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R is a response that first gives a brief overview of the topic and then asks the user what to focus on or whether to provide detail",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l4251_4571_n029", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "detail_overload_response", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R is a response that presents a large amount of detailed information all at once without first checking what the user wants to focus on",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l4251_4571_n029", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "open_planning_question", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "Q is a user question asking for general considerations on a broad planning task, such as planning a birthday party",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example's user question is open-ended and planning-related; the preference applies to this kind of question",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "answers_question", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "response R answers question Q",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the preference relates a response to the question it answers",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l4251_4571_n029", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "overview_then_detail_response(R)",
      "gloss": "R is a response that gives an overview and asks for direction, as in the good example",
      "body": "voice_turn_taking_rule(R)" },
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l4251_4571_n029", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "detail_overload_response(R)",
      "gloss": "R is a response that overloads the user with detail, as in the bad example",
      "body": "voice_turn_taking_rule(R)" }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "responding with % is preferred: a brief overview with an offer to elaborate suits an open-ended planning question",
      "read_back_slots": ["R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l4251_4571_n029", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "prefer", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "overview_then_detail_response(R), open_planning_question(Q), answers_question(R, Q)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "respond_with", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example states a preference between two permitted responses; it forbids nothing, so silence leaves responses permitted" }
  ],
  "requires": ["voice_turn_taking_rule/1"],
  "inputs": ["open_planning_question/1", "answers_question/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
